about: Reviewed vessels for the water repaint's protection mask and vessel hulls (pixelphilly.vessels; Stephen, Nov. 5, 2026). Outlines traced from the City of Philadelphia 2024 3-inch aerial (scripts/29_trace_vessels.py: color difference from the river, minus shadows and OSM piers), then reviewed one by one against the aerial. Heights: h_source 'lidar' = deck measured in the 2022 LiDAR for the same hull; 'shadow' = shadow length vs. a building of known height (an estimate); 'default' = by vessel kind (an assumption). base 'water' = hull stands on the water level (0 m NAVD88); 'ground' = in a dry dock, from the surrounding ground.

review._about: Reviewer's reading of each group's trace sheet (output/review/vessels/trace_<group>.jpg), Nov. 5, 2026. hulls: traces that are one vessel (or a nest of 'split' hulls side by side); shape ops: 'open:<m>' removes parts thinner than 2x m (pier strips, yards, a submarine alongside), 'hull' = convex hull (container ships cut by crane booms), 'rect' = minimum rotated rectangle (a deck edge the trace missed); flat = protected only, no 3D (under way). reject: traces that aren't vessels (quay edges, dock walls, cranes); unlisted traces are protected from the repaint but get no hull. clip: a lon/lat box [w,s,e,n] the hull is cut to first (one trace spanning two nests).
